request: How many ants are there on Earth? Let me guess on a log scale. #interactive #short
subtitle: Guess how many ants are alive on Earth, then see the 2022 count: twenty quadrillion, outweighing every wild bird and mammal combined.

spec.title: How many ants are there on Earth?

sources.title: The abundance, biomass, and distribution of ants on Earth
sources.authors: P. Schultheiss, S. S. Nooten, R. Wang et al.
sources.finding: about 20 quadrillion (2 × 10^16) ants, about 12 megatons of dry carbon: more than wild birds and wild mammals combined, about 20% of human biomass; a conservative estimate from 489 studies

card.title: How many ants are on Earth?

commands.speak: How many ants are alive on Earth right now?

ask.question: How many ants live on Earth? Click on the line: each step is ten times the last.
ask.right: Close: you said {a}, and it is about {a.true}.

commands.speak: That is twenty thousand trillion, or twenty quadrillion: a two followed by sixteen zeros.
The number comes from a 2022 study that pooled 489 ant counts, from rainforests to deserts.
Shared out, that is about two and a half million ants for every person alive.
Each ant weighs almost nothing, but together their bodies hold about twelve million tonnes of carbon.
That is more than all the wild birds and wild mammals on Earth put together.
And it is a low count: ants that live underground, and whole regions without surveys, were left out.
So next time you see one ant, spare a thought for the other twenty quadrillion.
